periodic() - Method in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.Controller
Runs the controller's periodic bookkeeping - call this from the owning subsystem's periodic() every loop.
periodic() - Method in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.SimulatedController
Advances the simulation by one 20ms loop: since a simulated mechanism has no real motor controller firmware running its closed loop, this method performs that role in software - computing an input voltage from the profiled PID controller, plain PID controller, or trapezoid profile depending on the configured ControlType, applying it, clamping the mechanism to its configured soft limits, updating the acceleration estimate, and stepping the underlying LinearSystemSim.
periodic() - Method in class frc.lib.NinjasLib.controllers.SparkMaxController
For PROFILED_PIDF and PROFILE control types, computes one step of the software trapezoid profile / profiled PID controller each loop and applies the result to the motor as a voltage-derived percent output (since the SparkMax has no built-in Motion Magic-style profiling); PIDF control is instead driven directly by the SparkMax's onboard closed loop in SparkMaxController.setPosition(double)/SparkMaxController.setVelocity(double).
